pages.name: Bonecrusher
pages.text: OGROID. 120 HP; 12 damage. A massive mountain scavenger wielding a stone club.

pages.title: Combat
pages.text: Dodge the long swing and ground smash (12–16 sec). At medium range a roar warns of a charge (15–20 sec), stopped by walls. A missed heavy attack opens a counter window: +25 percent incoming damage for 1.4 seconds.

pages.title: Weaknesses and habitat
pages.text: Below 35 percent HP enters rage once: +20 percent speed, faster attacks and charge; damage stays unchanged. Ogroid oil: +15 percent for 40 successful melee hits from inventory. Rare singleton in mountains, rocky shores and large dripstone/deep caves; supports suitable BOP biomes.
Essence 85 percent, fang 25 percent, head 3 percent, club 6 percent. Head and club require a player or tamed ally kill.

pages.title: Unique equipment
pages.text: See $(l:hunter_equipment)Hunter Equipment$(/l) for the hammer and vampire fangs.
